g.text: 500 requested counterfactual annotations | 500 paired bootstrap draws per estimable cell
Lower RMSE is better; positive percentages denote lower error than DM
RMSE = sqrt(mean(squared policy-value error over 500 draws)). Percent change = 100 x (DM - DM+) / DM.
All model columns are DM+. Red percentages denote higher RMSE. NE: no sodium dosage target-validation patients.
500 is the requested annotation budget; valid cached replies range from 485 to 500 in estimable cells, with no replacement.
Reference: observed target-cohort mean reward proxy. Underlying full-precision RMSE, Monte Carlo SE, t and p are included in CSV.
